content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML sections.
The run failed with an AssertionError in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the environment setup and basic file generation worked (3 tests passed), the mapping of '위험등급' to its corresponding severity label in the HWPX output was incorrect or missing.
